name: Index-Based Upsampling with Recalibration
definition: A technique to upsample low-resolution tensors to high resolution using an index map and a recalibration map, specifically for depth values.
summary: Index-Based Upsampling with Recalibration upsamples low-resolution tensors to high resolution by gathering values via an index map and scaling them with a recalibration map, differing from sibling methods by relying on explicit index and scaling tensors rather than depth-weighted interpolation.
